title: Blood Transfusion Management in Patients With Mitral Valve Replacement in China
brief_summary: The evaluation uses ΔHb as an independent factor combined with artificial intelligence (AI) to predict its impact on the prognosis and blood transfusion of patients undergoing cardiac surgery, thereby guiding perioperative clinical blood use and improving patient prognosis.
study_population: Patients with "mitral valve replacement" surgery who meet the standard in China, 18\<Age\<75.
